query:
SELECT sp."linkShare"
                    FROM (
                        SELECT share_permission_id FROM calls WHERE id = $1
                        UNION ALL
                        SELECT share_permission_id FROM call_records WHERE id = $1
                    ) call_permission
                    JOIN "SharePermission" sp ON sp.id = call_permission.share_permission_id
                    LIMIT 1
                    FOR UPDATE OF sp
